evidence.maker_source: n/a; M2 via-to-opening rule (>= 0.1 mm) and DRC pass

findings.impact: Not a demonstrated failure; DRC and the M2 via-to-opening rule pass. It is an untidy pad-entry pattern (M2 review item; AVA-unlike): each fanout leaves the outer pad inward under the part to a via between the pads, where a bridge or tent defect cannot be inspected. The electrical effect of a bridge is small: R89 / R91 lose their pull-up (BAT_FAULT_N / LOGIC_SOURCE_ST tied to 3V3, a diagnostic loss), R101 joins CAM_UART_OE to the camera TX path, R86 / R401 / R403 already sit 0.25 mm from GND pour (Inference). Two of the vias (R86.2, R91.1) are also what squeeze BAT_FAULT_N to 0.18 / 0.38 mm (R19-RTE-03). None of this is recorded.
findings.concrete_fix: Record the six in R10_VALIDATION section 6 (count and locations). In a respin, place each fanout via beyond the outer end of its own pad, screened per instance; not fix-now.
